metadata.title: uibc-core v0.2.1: verifiable evidence packages for autonomous AI agents (PROPOSAL)
metadata.description: Reference implementation of UIBC (Unified Identity-Behavior-Continuity) Core: agent lifecycle evidence packages with Registry/Evidence/Gates (LGD). Includes verifier, HMAC seals, golden attack fixtures, independent second implementation, UIBC-MEM verifiable memory migration, MCP server, A2A adapter, contest package. PROPOSAL - scoped proofs, not absolute trust.
